audit.scope: raw collected files in C:/Users/Mohammed856/finengine-raw-odd (read-only); no network, no data/**, no AWS/Supabase
audit.method: SHA-256 recomputed for every audited file (tools/rec.py). All 19 inventory files were opened and identified (tools/survey.py). Statement pages of 18 filings were read: the six whole-file scans (FY2022, Q1/H1/9M 2022, Q1 2023), the Q1 2024 income statement and cash flow (image-only pages inside a text file) and every other filing whose text layer drops parentheses (2023 to Q1/H1 2025) were rendered and read by eye (tools/pg.py, tools/sheet.py); the 9M 2025, FY2025, Q1 2026 and H1 2026 filings were read from the text layer (tools/auto.py) and cross-checked against renders and later comparatives. Several digits misread on first pass (for example G&A 16,860,468 and parent profit 27,249,386 in the 9M 2022 scan) were caught by arithmetic and by later filings' comparatives before recording. tools/check_transcripts.py over transcripts/6090.json checks balance sheet identity, cash-flow sum and roll, gross profit including the biological-asset fair-value line, profit before zakat plus discontinued operations to net profit, owners + non-controlling interests, rolls and agreement of every comparative with the original; the differences are declared restatements.

value_correctness.summary: Headline values in full Saudi riyals (SAR). FY2025: revenue 107,846,916, profit before zakat 1,581,400, net profit 2,651,760, total assets 536,007,895, cash from operations 23,228,126; FY2024: revenue 78,703,147, net loss (153,499,750), total assets 520,602,948; FY2023 as filed: revenue 84,331,249, net profit 1,523,667, total assets 618,379,075; FY2022 as filed: net profit 16,497,513; H1 2026 revenue 78,164,226, net loss (1,947,445). All identities hold with zero difference except one printed transposition (FY2024 financing (897,250) should be (879,250)). Comparatives are heavily restated and every difference is declared with both values: FY2022 (net profit 16,497,513 -> 9,868,072; operating cash flow (30,856,834) -> (7,856,830)), FY2023 (net profit 1,523,667 -> (32,336,333); total liabilities 110,570,612 -> 144,430,612 via a 33,860,000 guarantee-commitment loss), Q1 2024 (net loss (41,018,991) -> (107,958,991)), H1 2024 ((53,477,799) -> (120,417,799)), 9M 2024 ((72,473,858) -> (139,413,858)), 2023 interims (biological-asset gain regrouped; discontinued operations separated), 9M 2022 cash flow (25,000,000 moved from operating to investing), and 2025 cost of revenues grossed up with the fair-value gain in the 2026 filings (gross profit unchanged). A consumer must choose original versus restated values explicitly.

document_completeness.summary: 18 files carry all primary statements. Six are whole-file scans classed scanned_unreadable or partial (2022 Q1/H1/9M, 2023 Q1, FY2022 label 2023|FY, plus Q1 2022 classed partial_statements); the Q1 2024 file has image-only income statement and cash flow pages (inventory says financial_statements) and its sibling text files lose parentheses so a text extractor returns wrong signs (FY2023 filing even prints three balance sheet columns, so last-two-columns extraction returns the restated 2022 column as current). 38696e57 labelled 2025|9M is the Board of Directors annual report 2025 (92 pages), not a 9M filing; the real 9M 2025 filing is c5b60505. The company was renamed (Jazan Energy and Development Company (JAZADCO) to Jazan Development and Investment Company) in 2023/2024.
